name_en: Abel theorem on inversion of elliptic integrals
canonical_name: Abel's elliptic-integral inversion theorem family (exact formulation open)
candidate_statement_family_not_credited: Under source-selected nonsingularity, branch, normalization, and period conventions, the inverse of a genus-one elliptic integral extends to a single-valued doubly periodic meromorphic function; the exact integral, inverse relation, domain, codomain, and conclusion remain open.
statement_blocker: The catalog supplies only a noun phrase. It does not fix the elliptic integral or curve, parameters and nonsingularity, basepoint, paths and branches, normalization and periods, local versus global or quotient-valued inverse, domain and codomain, conclusion, or boundary cases. Selecting a familiar Legendre, Jacobi, or Weierstrass statement would invent proposition-changing scope and could substitute THM-M-0239 or THM-M-0240.
domain_and_universes: Open: source-selected real or complex elliptic integral, algebraic curve or branched cover, coefficients or modulus, paths and branches, period lattice, and local, planar, quotient, or curve-valued inverse model. Exact universes and typeclass context remain open.
conclusion: Open: no exact existence, inverse identity, meromorphic continuation, double-periodicity, differential-equation, addition-law, or uniformization conclusion is selected by the repository record.
degenerate_case_status: Not frozen. The statement phase must resolve discriminant zero or repeated roots, zero and limiting moduli, branch points, endpoints, poles and lattice points, path dependence, empty domains, and every source-dependent boundary convention.
candidate_scope_not_credited: a local analytic inverse of a selected elliptic integral on one branch
a globally continued doubly periodic meromorphic inverse on the complex plane
a complex-torus-to-elliptic-curve uniformization after checked inverse and quotient transports
a Legendre, Jacobi, or Weierstrass normal form after source-approved equivalence proofs

neighbor_target_boundaries.boundary: separate general Jacobi-inversion target; no generalized Abelian-integral, genus, proof, or receipt credit transfers
separate Abel-Jacobi/Jacobian target; no divisor-map, Jacobian, proof, or receipt credit transfers

excluded_substitutions: Abel's theorem on sums of algebraic integrals
Jacobi inversion for general Abelian integrals or the Abel-Jacobi theorem
construction, periodicity, meromorphicity, pole order, or the differential equation of the Weierstrass P function without a checked inverse relation
a convenient fixed-modulus, real-interval, local-inverse, or assumed-inverse special case absent source approval
the catalog's untrusted verified label, an API probe, or another target's artifact treated as source or proof credit
